attempts.summary: Configured tc (HTB egress + ingress redirect via ifb0) on node1's br-lan interface to cap traffic to/from node2 (10.100.149.11) to ~1 Mbit/s in each direction, while all other traffic through node1 (e.g. to/from node3) stays unshaped. Demonstrated the limit with iperf3 transfers in both directions, made the shaping persistent via /etc/rc.local, and completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, verifying boot-identity change and post-restart recovery on each.
